newsletter_capability_detail: Their platform architecture names the sources they monitor and newsletters are absent: "We monitor 35+ public data sources continuously: SEC EDGAR, LinkedIn, job boards, patent databases, Glassdoor, Reddit, GitHub, news feeds, earnings call transcripts, and more." Podcast transcripts are extracted, but no newsletter publications. Searched: /platform, /integrations, autobound-api.readme.io docs, site-restricted 'newsletter' searches (results were only their blog posts about email marketing).
verified_gap: No newsletter source in the documented 35+ source list, so no newsletter-derived signals: no publication-level topics, no sponsor relationships, no article timestamps. Their closest documented analogue is podcast transcripts, which shows the extraction pipeline could accept long-form newsletter text but does not currently ingest it.
